newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares off lows, may rally Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares off lows, may rally Tuesday.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Shares closed down but off their lows in a sign that there could be an attempt at a rally on Tuesday, traders said. Much will depend on how New York closes, they added.
*The PSI20 .PSI20 index closed 0.71 percent down at 7,743.56 points having fallen 1.7 percent at one point during the session.

*Another factor which could influence trade on Tuesday will be the results of Banco Espirito Santo due to be released at 0900 GMT, shortly after the market opens. It is the first of the big banks to issue first half figures. Banco Comercial Portugues posts its figures at around 1700 GMT tomorrow.
*Analysts are looking for BES to post profit of 13 to 15 billion escudos.

*The decline in the index took place in relatively low volume. Some 60 percent of the 23 billion escudo cash turnover was made up of 4.4 million shares of construction company Mota & Companhia floated on the bourse on Monday.
*The sale of the 500,000 shares was fixed at 2,950 escudos.
